articles.title: Which Iranian officials have been killed in US-Israel attacks along with Supreme Leader Ayotollah Khamenei? Full list
articles.summary: Iranian state media confirmed the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on Sunday morning, reportedly after a massive US-Israeli airstrike on Iran. This incident is being described as a significant blow to Iran. The original report also mentions US President Donald Trump in connection with the events, highlighting the international and geopolitical implications of this major development.

articles.title: More explosions heard in Dubai, Doha and Manama
articles.summary: New blasts rocked Gulf cities like Dubai, Doha, and Manama, following Iranian retaliatory strikes. This escalation comes after previous US and Israeli attacks, underscoring severe geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. SSB aspirants should note the region's instability and its potential global defence implications, highlighting the complex dynamics between key regional and international players.
